findings.impact: Cross-tenant disclosure (AC-05) if the `unsafe.stringConcatSql` switch were reachable in production.
findings.rationale: The string-built query exists only behind an options flag that no server entry point sets; it is the negative control proving the AC-05 oracle can fail. Removing the control would leave AC-05 without evidence of oracle strength.
